verdict.rationale: Viam advertises cloud-managed fleet monitoring and alerting with remote monitoring in its fleet-management tier. Its fleet API organizes machines by organization and location, the browser app lets you monitor machines from anywhere and visualize machine state, and GetMachineStatus reports resource health and why a resource is unhealthy. Missing for 10: a documented single fleet-wide dashboard view of health and status across all machines, geographic location tracking (beyond organizational 'locations'), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the fleet monitoring UI.
